subject: Re: Air freight quotes for CAI and TLV
body:
Thanks for your offer. We’re happy to go ahead on that basis for both shipments. Please book only the first shipment for now. We’ll confirm the second shipment later.

Thanks a lot and have a lovely day!
Petra Hofmann
Export Desk, Hofmann Textilwerk KG

classification.reasoning: The customer accepts the quote and asks us to book the first shipment, while deferring the second.
